shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && cat /workspace/package.json
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || echo "NO DOCS DIR"
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; echo "---CONFIG---"; cat /workspace/next.config.ts; echo "---TSCONFIG---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
grep -ril "view.?transition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "viewtransition\|view transition\|ViewTransition" . | head -30; echo "=== ls 01-app ==="; ls 01-app
cd /workspace && cat app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx
cat app/layout.tsx; echo "=== DETAIL PAGE ==="; cat 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'; echo "=== PRODUCTS ==="; cat lib/products.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && echo "=== LINK transitionTypes ==="; grep -n -A 40 -i "transitionTypes" 01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80
grep -n -B 5 -A 25 -i "viewtransition\|view transition" 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md

cd /workspace && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60; echo "=== react version ==="; cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/react/index.js node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

echo "=== vendored react ViewTransition ==="; grep -ro "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react*/ -d 2>/dev/null; echo "=== types ==="; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -10; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
head -40 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== does canary declare module react ==="; grep -n "declare module\|export {}\|^}" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -10

grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/*link*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "=== next-env ==="; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "no next-env.d.ts yet"
sed -n '44,100p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -10; echo "--- exit:$? ---"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "=== tsc exit: $? ==="
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -35

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== HOME ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o "product-image[^\"]*\|Classic Sneakers\|product-grid" | sort -u; echo "=== DETAIL ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "product-hero\|product-info\|Timeless design[^<]*\|back-link" | sort -u; echo "=== SERVER LOG ==="; tail -5 /tmp/srv.log

echo "=== detail page morph name + nav types ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "product-image-classic-sneakers\|nav-back\|nav-forward\|morph" | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== home nav types ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o "nav-forward\|nav-back\|morph\|slide-up\|slide-down" | sort | uniq -c

CSS=$(curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1); echo "CSS: $CSS"; curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" | grep -o "view-transition-[a-z-]*([^)]*)\|prefers-reduced-motion\|via-blur\|slide-offset" | sort -u

CSS=$(curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1); curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" | grep -o "::view-transition{[^}]*}" ; echo "--- reduced motion block ---"; curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" | grep -o "@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.*" | head -c 600; pkill -f "next start" ; echo; echo "server stopped"
git --no-pager diff --stat && echo "=== NEW FILES ===" && git status --short
git --no-pager diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== .gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && git --no-pager diff --stat tsconfig.json && git status --short
rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git --no-pager diff app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx'
